name: Mrs. Vextross
source:
[url=/c175732]Layla[/url]'s mother. She's a sweet woman who can cook like no other. She spent a lot of time watching [url=/c175728]Flynn[/url] when he was younger so that his mother could work to make ends meet after Flynn's father was no longer around.
